service.description: Comms Home for the current user, over the user's mail and chat. cardList: the counters, each {key, title, value, icon, link}: one per mail account with its unread Inbox mail, Flagged, Snoozed (back by the end of today), Mentions (chat), Not sent (sends that failed) and Missed calls (not seen yet). roomList: the chat rooms with unread, ten at most. needsReplyList, followUpList, meetingList and mailboxList are an app's (its inbox-source answers this operation) and empty here. hasMailAccount is false until the user has a mail account; problemAccountList names the accounts whose sign-in or sync failed, with canManage (only a manager fixes one). failedParts names what could not be read.
